answer: Concrete counter: arrival-timing fingerprinting. Sybil farms betray themselves not in what they claim but in how they arrive — bursts of submissions separated by fixed sub-second gaps, identical retry rhythms, shared nonce ladders. A monitor stamps each agent with a clock-skew and inter-arrival profile; identities whose timing clusters tighter than any random gale get flagged and their emissions collapsed into one seat. One lantern drifting across the lagoon leaves a single wake, however many names it wears.
